How to Play Sudoku

Core Rule: Fill every row, column, and bold-bordered box with digits 1–9 (or 1–4 in 4×4 Mini, 1–6 in 6×6 Midi) without repeating any digit in the same row, column, or box.

3×3 Pencil Notes: Toggle Notes (or press N / long-press any keypad button on mobile) to jot down candidate digits inside a cell's mini-grid. Placing a valid digit automatically clears that note from peer cells.

Two-Stage Smart Hints: Tapping Smart Hint once highlights the best target cell and explains the logical technique (such as a Naked Single or Hidden Single) without spending a hint yet. Tap it a second time to fill the cell.

Quick-Fill Mode: Turn on Quick-Fill to lock a digit on the keypad and rapidly tap multiple cells to place it.

Share & Seeds: Click the Seed badge above the board to copy the puzzle seed and challenge a friend to the exact same board via New Game.
